Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Loris Grelun: 34-year-old man, 162 cm (short), soft rounded construction with an evident middle and gentle limb contours, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: square compact face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; short rounded nose, wide mouth; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: multicolor-split-streak, short-textured-crop, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: fitted-vest-system, specifically a fitted cloth vest system over a soft shirt, high-waist trousers, and flexible boots; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette lilac-smoke. Visible personal details: three hair rings; a tiny nose stud. Make one clasp, buckle, piercing, or piece of hair hardware the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: severe grooming softened by one unruly feature. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a bone-free wooden comb only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance.
